checkpoint.contextAtWrite: Ran wugs-s8's complete inner loop in one stretch. New failure mode discovered and handled correctly this session: a dispatched implementer subagent spawned its own background npm-test process and then reported it was 'waiting for the background task to complete on its own' -- but subagents cannot receive background-task completion notifications (only the orchestrating session can). Recognized this immediately as matching a known documented pattern (memory: 'Agent false-waits on background tasks'), did not wait for a report that would never arrive, checked the worktree's actual git status/diff directly instead (confirmed all four implementation steps were genuinely done, just uncommitted), ran the full suite myself in the foreground, and completed the commit personally. No work was lost or needed redoing.
